name: application-map-marker-popup
title: Map Marker Popup
description: Floating cards anchored to a map pin with a title, thumbnail or icon, meta details, and a directions call to action for geo interfaces.
useWhen: Floating cards anchored to a map pin with a title, thumbnail or icon, meta details, and a directions call to action for geo interfaces.
avoidWhen: Avoid map marker popup when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Map Marker Popup uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Provide meaningful alternative text for informative images and empty alt text for decorative images.
Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
